Shipment Data Completeness: Detecting Missing Attributes

9 min read Updated: November 2026 By Rajvardhan Singh Rathore
Incomplete freight data represents one of the primary drivers of warehouse processing delays and customs rejection. Learn the engineering patterns for detecting missing values and enforcing completeness contracts.

The Operational Cost of Missing Data

When an air cargo manifest lacks a Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) code or a parcel milestone lacks a destination postal code, downstream routing engines cannot allocate delivery sorters. In automated sorting facilities, incomplete records trigger exception lane diverts, degrading operational throughput by up to 18%.

Detecting 'Hidden' NULLs

In carrier integrations, missing values frequently arrive disguised as non-null dummy strings:

  • Empty string: ""
  • Whitespace only: " "
  • Default string tokens: "NULL", "N/A", "UNKNOWN", "00000", "undefined"
  • Zero coordinates: lat: 0.0, lon: 0.0 (Null Island)
The Null Island Trap

GPS tracking units with uncalibrated satellite fixes often default to latitude 0.0, longitude 0.0 (off the coast of Ghana). Unless caught during cleaning, standard distance calculations will flag shipments as teleporting across the Atlantic Ocean.

SQL Completeness Matrix Analysis

Use the following normalized NULL-scrubber pattern to assess completeness across all staging columns:

PostgreSQL SQL 
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
  -- Check true nulls and hidden nulls
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(carrier_code), '') IS NULL OR UPPER(TRIM(carrier_code)) IN ('N/A', 'UNKNOWN', 'NULL') THEN 1 END)::numeric / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS carrier_code_missing_pct,
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(origin_postal_code), '') IS NULL OR origin_postal_code IN ('00000', '99999') THEN 1 END)::numeric / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS origin_postal_missing_pct,
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(destination_postal_code), '') IS NULL THEN 1 END)::numeric / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS dest_postal_missing_pct,
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN (latitude = 0.0 AND longitude = 0.0) OR latitude IS NULL THEN 1 END)::numeric / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS gps_missing_pct
FROM raw_carrier_milestones
WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days';

Automated Backfill & Fallback Pipelines

When missing fields are detected, production pipelines utilize a multi-level fallback cascade:

  1. Reference Master Manifest: Look up destination details in the upstream shipper ERP Order table using purchase_order_number.
  2. Carrier Master API Lookup: Asynchronously call the carrier tracking REST endpoint to retrieve official delivery coordinates.
  3. Quarantine Staging: If critical routing keys cannot be resolved within 30 minutes, route to the Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) for human operator review.
